t: What Does Buy Into Something Mean? - Writing Explained
s: March 3, 2017 - Because it was too risky to invest in just one ship (pirates, illness, weather), investors could now put their money into a company and still earn a profit if just one or two ships completed their journey, even if several others never made it back to port. It is possible that this phrasal verb was in use by then, but it is unlikely. The first written recordings are not until the early 1900s. Originally, the phrase was buy in, probably because you had stocks in the company.
